description: Spending on Roads and Bridges in KPK is a dataset listed in Open Data Pakistan portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Center in Big Data and Cloud Computing (NCBC). This data set provides a list of the total amount spent on M&R (maintenance and repair) of Roads & Bridges in KP Districts during the year 2016 to 2019. Coverage: Pakistan. The portal files it under the publisher National Center in Big Data and Cloud Computing (NCBC). Its tags are KPK, amount, bridges, roads, spending. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2021-04-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-pk-od-portal.
